title: R' Tanchum of Jaffa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesikta deRav Kahana, beginning of piska “BaChatzi HaLailah,” speaking in R' Nechunya’s name; in Pesikta Rabbati there he speaks in the name of R' Mana of Caesarea.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Mandelbaum digital Pesikta deRav Kahana 7:1 writes abbreviated Tanchum of Jaffa in the name of Nunya of Caesarea; Hyman’s Nechunya is retained. The entire OYW Pesikta Rabbati 17 paragraph writes abbreviated Tanchum and “(Anya) [Mana] of Caesarea.” These are local textual comparisons, without title expansion, name harmonization or printed-edition collation.
